summary: Frontend testing of newly-built Admin Panel for Grihkari. 8 of 9 scenarios PASS. Scenario 7 (logout via Alert.alert) FAILS on web because react-native-web's Alert.alert does not invoke multi-button callbacks reliably — clicking admin-logout shows no confirmation dialog and never clears the admin token or navigates back to /(admin)/login. All other flows (direct nav to admin login, wrong/correct password auth, dashboard listing, debounced search + clear, reset modal with min-6 inline error, secure password generator producing 8-char value, success modal with name/phone/password, Done dismiss, actual client login with newly generated password redirecting to /(client)/home, password restoration back to test123, and long-press shirt logo discreet admin entry with delayLongPress=1200) all worked correctly. Test users restored: client 9999999992 password reset back to test123 and verified via /api/auth/login (200 OK).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping admin-logout fires Alert.alert with two buttons (Cancel / Sign out). On react-native-web the multi-button onPress callback never runs, so clearAdminToken() and router.replace('/(admin)/login') never fire. URL stays on /dashboard and admin-password-input is never rendered. Verified twice, including with window.confirm = () => true mock. Affects only the web preview; native should be fine. Replace Alert.alert with a custom <Modal> confirmation OR branch on Platform.OS === 'web' to use window.confirm directly. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(admin)/dashboard.tsx:123-135

issues: Console deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow). Appears on admin login logo + primaryBtn shadows. Non-blocking but should migrate. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(admin)/login.tsx:168-172, primaryBtn shadow.

react_native_issues.issue: Multi-button Alert.alert callbacks are not fired on web preview, breaking the admin logout flow. Use a custom <Modal> for confirmations or Platform.OS branch with window.confirm. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(admin)/dashboard.tsx:123-135

Both files compile to the same URL path /login under expo-router. Direct browser nav to either group works, but in-app router.push('/(admin)/login') and router.push('/(auth)/login') rely on group disambiguation. Verified long-press path works, but worth noting in case future group-less navigation lands on the wrong screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(admin)/login.tsx, /app/frontend/app/(auth)/login.tsx

action_items: Replace Alert.alert in /app/frontend/app/(admin)/dashboard.tsx logout() with a custom React Native <Modal> confirmation (consistent with the existing reset/success modals) OR use Platform.OS === 'web' branch invoking window.confirm. Without this, helpline operators cannot sign out via web preview.
Optional: migrate deprecated `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` in admin login + dashboard styles to silence console warnings.
Optional: be aware that /(admin)/login and /(auth)/login share the URL /login; if you ever add deep linking, prefix one route or rename to avoid ambiguity.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.ts adminRequest correctly forwards admin token as query string and handles 401 by clearing token + redirecting; good.
dashboard.tsx debounced search (300ms) and pull-to-refresh work as expected.
Reset password validation client-side: enforces min 6 chars before hitting backend; success payload computed before closeReset() to avoid race — clean.
Generated password uses 31-char alphabet, length 8 ⇒ ~40 bits entropy; fine for helpline temp passwords.
useEffect in admin login auto-redirects to dashboard if token already cached — good UX but means logging out must reliably clear the token; current logout bug compounds this on web.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Verified existing test users (9999999991 iron_man, 9999999992 client) intact. Reset client password to a generated value, verified login works, then restored to test123 via admin panel and re-verified via /api/auth/login (200 OK). /app/memory/test_credentials.md unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel mostly works. Only failing flow is the logout button due to Alert.alert behavior on react-native-web. After E1 fixes logout, retest scenarios 7 and 8 (sign out + re-login after sign out). Admin token is stored via secureStore wrapper (localStorage on web) under key 'grihkari_admin_token'. Backend admin token format: 'admin:<password>' i.e. 'admin:grihkari-admin-2026'.
rca_of_issue: Issue: admin-logout button does not sign user out on web. RCA: dashboard.tsx logout() calls Alert.alert('Sign out?', '...', [{text:'Cancel', style:'cancel'}, {text:'Sign out', style:'destructive', onPress: async () => { await clearAdminToken(); router.replace('/(admin)/login'); }}]). react-native-web's Alert.alert implementation does NOT call the destructive button's onPress callback for two-button alerts — it either no-ops or uses window.alert (single-message) which never triggers the second handler. Reproduction: log into admin, tap testID='admin-logout', observe URL stays at /dashboard and dashboard remains visible. Mitigation: (a) replace Alert.alert with a custom RN <Modal> (preferred — matches existing reset/success modals); (b) Platform.OS === 'web' branch using window.confirm(); (c) library like react-native-paper Dialog. Option (a) is the cleanest fix.
